overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the committee could amend its notice within 48 hours to add a topic that was not reasonably anticipated 48 hours before the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the committee added a topic to its February 6 meeting notice within 48 hours of the meeting, the topic being his own complaint.
